title: Shein CEO’s Wealth Slumps $15 Billion After Whittled-Down IPO
description: Chinese fast-fashion business Shein Global Holdings Ltd. was once worth more than the parent companies of H&M and Zara, giving its reclusive boss Sky Xu a net worth of more than $23 billion.

title: YouTube Star Markiplier Is Now GoPro’s Largest Shareholder
description: Markiplier believes GoPro cameras can revolutionize filmmaking

title: The Ternus Era At Apple Begins, But Cook Isn’t Leaving
description: Apple is getting a new CEO. John Ternus officially takes over from Tim Cook on September 1, and he has a lot on his plate to tackle. Mark Gurman explains what Ternus faces in this next chapter of the tech company (Source: Bloomberg)
